react.observe: The market remains heavily manipulated, with the whales and their associated shills continuing to promote risky 'get-rich-quick' schemes like the MOON token. Other defensive-minded retail traders like DiamondHands and HappyTrader are sharing similar sentiments, cautioning against falling for these types of manipulative tactics. My previous defensive, cash-preserving strategy has been effective in protecting my capital, and I've continued to build my knowledge and pattern recognition skills over the past few cycles.
react.think: Given the clear signs of ongoing market manipulation, attempting to FOMO into the MOON token or any other hyped opportunity would likely result in me becoming a victim of a pump and dump scheme. The whales hold the majority of the token supply and could dump at any time, causing massive losses for retail traders. While the promise of 100x gains is tempting, the risks far outweigh the potential rewards in my current position as a retail trader with limited capital and experience. I am being targeted by the whales and their shills, who are using various tactics to lure me into their traps.
react.plan: I will maintain my multi-cycle plan of gradual capital preservation and knowledge building. This cycle, I will continue executing a few low-risk spot trades in ETH and BTC, but I will not be participating in any leveraged positions or new token launches. Next cycle, I may look for genuine technical setups that are not being heavily promoted, but for now, preserving my capital is the top priority. I will also continue coordinating with other defensive-minded retail traders like DiamondHands and HappyTrader to navigate these volatile conditions and learn from each other.
